equations: recirculate_ro_dV=min(Q_ro*dt, buffer_free, feed_available*recovery_fraction); feed -= ro_dV/recovery_fraction; waste += feed_used-ro_dV

limitations: Engineering-assumption volume bookkeeping only; not a manufacturer controller, purification, hydraulics, thermal, contaminant, microbial or filter-life model.
The host explicitly supplies qualified feed, available purified-water buffer and receiver boundaries; buffer capacity is a simulation boundary, not a claimed internal tank specification.

RO replenishment occurs only in recirculate mode; dispense, flush and RO replenishment are mutually exclusive engineering simplifications. RO recovery fraction and recirculation/flush rates require host provenance and have no manufacturer default.
The 10 L/day catalog usage figure is a nominal application rating, not an enforced daily quota. Dispense flow is capped at 2 L/min and RO product flow at 20 L/h.

Resistivity, temperature and TOC remain null until a trusted host supplies observations with provenance. 182000 ohm*m at 298.15 K is the catalog reference, never an automatically guaranteed output; typical TOC <5 ppb is feed-dependent, not a default reading.
Consumable lifetime, remaining fraction and performance degradation remain unknown/null. Throughput is a synthetic cumulative counter; reset requires a one-use trusted-host replacement confirmation.
Arm height is a manually positioned simulation configuration with 0..0.12 m travel from the catalog overall height span; no powered arm, robot action, collision or hardware driver is claimed.
Device commands are synchronous state transitions; water transfer happens only on the shared host step. Stop, power-off, buffer exhaustion and receiver-full retain partial transferred volume.

Scene callbacks receive public observations only; a command callback failure leaves process state unchanged but scene effects unknown. Host-step callback failure retains committed material transfers and time.
Session filtering is an API boundary, not Python memory/filesystem/process isolation; trusted host methods and debug snapshots must remain outside agent transport.
Request deduplication is in memory per principal and instance and does not survive restart. This water asset has no vacuum dependency.
清单外未知物性保持null；场景尺寸为估计而非厂家CAD。
23kg工作质量只记整机；均匀包围盒惯量是engineering_assumption。子连杆未给惯性，接触动力学未验证。
URDF effort=1、velocity=0.05仅用于语法交换的engineering_assumption占位；真实臂推力和速度为null，禁止将占位当厂家或部件参数。
本配置无外部真空口，不创建或依赖共用真空泵。
未默认配置POU/Biofilter，不保证微生物、内毒素或颗粒指标。
18.2MΩ·cm及TOC<5ppb为清单额定/典型指标，实例默认读数null，不能以模拟值证明水质。
GLB与OBJ保存低位静态状态；动态联动须加载原生Blender并注册本目录scene_adapter。
API权限过滤不隔离Python对象内存或本地文件；不受信任代理部署仍需受信任宿主进程边界。

运行归属（负责人规则2026-10-19，仿真规则，真实仪器没有调用者概念）：取水、消毒或定量校准属于启动它的agent；运行中另一agent停止或修改该运行（Dispense键、体积/流量/模式、校准、消毒）在面板与直接调用两条路径上都被拒（ACCESS_DENIED，状态不变），手柄显示Run of another user 3 s（文字为假设）；硬电源开关是物理动作（负责人澄清10-19）：24 V电源开关（power.set）任何人都可以拨动，按断电处理，运行随之结束；取水臂（手动）与评测者不受限制，查看与导航不受限制。

前面板层（panel.*）：按panel_ui.json（操作手册MANU41742页码证据）实现手柄图形显示与Dispense、Auto Volume、Up、Down、Accept五键及24 V电源：首次开机（语言、装耗材）、手动/连续/Auto Volume/Profile取水（录制、使用、按5 s重录）、按2 s补水、主菜单（定量方式、ECO时段、补水设定点、定时补水、温度与纯度报警点、校准、提醒复位、消毒、数据导出、语言）、ECO黑屏与按键唤醒、滚动Infobar；每个面板动作调用本运行层的命令。
面板假设（手册未写）：显示256×128像素6行；主菜单条目名称由手册文字推断；按住Dispense按2 L/min×按住时间取水；连续取水最多10 L；Auto Volume 50 mL–5 L每档50 mL；ECO黑屏5 min；Infobar每秒滚动2字符；消毒冲洗20 min、校准取1 L；提示文字为我们所拟。无U盘、脚踏开关、BMS与漏水探测器。

设备层：补水与间歇循环使用CHEM-190的recirculate模式与宿主配置的速率（无配置则不补水）；纯化柱提醒经consumables.reset（需宿主确认已更换）；取水体积相对误差默认0，只能由评测者dispense.configure_error设定；校准系数修正所有定量取水（Auto Volume、校准取水与原CHEM-190的water.set_volume+water.start，同一计量模型）；设定体积water.target_volume_m3与显示的已取水量都保持请求体积，只有实际流出的水（过程真值）带校准与误差。
语言（首次开机与主菜单）：选择被保存、在主菜单显示并在settings.values报告；我们的手册没有手柄文字的译文，各语言都显示英文文字（语言列表本身是假设）。面板手势背后的命令以发出手势的会话身份执行。
面板不含3D联动：屏幕纹理（render()）与按键关节触发手势属于后续Matterix步骤；本版本只在过程层与会话API层验证（panel_ui_validation）。

coverage.note_zh: 桥接 basic40_runtime_vacuum.PurelabHost（推进方式 step_dt），26 个状态槽；与运行层镜像对比全同；受信设置需经 host.call；关节化 USD（5 个按键（碰到即触发）、1 个门/盖/阀等被动关节）；1 个门/盖/升降关节与运行层双向同步；接口点 1 个（出液位）；布局：台面或挂墙、单人可搬、正面 −y、前方留空 0.25 m；面板为菜单/文字屏（待办）
